author: Swinhoe, 1873
summary: 우리나라에는 지금까지 기록이 10건이 안 되는 길잃은새로, 소택지, 논, 습지의 풀숲, 호소 등에서 산다. 뜸부기 무리 가운데 가장 작은 편에 든다. 풀밭이나 풀 사이 땅 위에 물풀 잎으로 접시 모양 둥지를 짓고 알을 6개 낳으며, 알은 크림빛 갈색 바탕에 적갈색 반점이 흩어져 있다. 일본, 중국 동부, 한카호, 바이칼, 우수리 등지에 분포하며, 세계적으로 희귀한 종으로 알려져 있다.

fine white bars on the back

art.subject: Swinhoe's Rail (Coturnicops exquisitus), adult, as seen on migration: upperparts olive-brown with many black spots and narrow white cross-bars on the back and wing coverts; crown dark brown; face buffy-brown; chin and throat white; breast warm yellowish-brown; belly white; flanks barred dark brown and white. Bill short, dark brown; legs and feet pale brown.
art.scene: Korean marsh and rice-paddy edge with dense wet grass during migration; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view standing: olive-brown upperparts with black spots and fine white bars, yellowish-brown breast, white belly, barred flanks, short dark brown bill, pale brown legs
adult, top view: olive-brown back densely marked with black spots and narrow white cross-bars
adult, flight seen from above with legs dangling: white patch on the secondaries contrasting with the dark olive-brown wing
art.build: Tiny, very secretive rail, about 15cm, about the size of a sparrow but plumper and shorter-tailed. Round body, small head and short neck. Bill short, much shorter than the head, stubby and slightly conical. Legs short to medium, pale brown, with long toes. Wings fold over the back at rest; the tail is tiny. Flies weakly and briefly with legs dangling, showing a clean white patch on the secondaries, its key mark.
avoid: Do not paint a long bill like Water Rail; the bill is short and stubby.
Do not paint a grey face and breast like Baillon's Crake (Zapornia pusilla); the breast is yellowish-brown.
Do not make it larger than a sparrow.
Do not paint plain, unmarked upperparts; the back is spotted black and barred white.
